title: INVOL (REACC) ? VOL (Pre-Move, -ve Earlier) � Negative VOL NOT Deducted (Customer Mitigating)
goal: System auto-rebooked via REACC (INVOL) to arrival 18:00, then customer voluntarily changed to an EARLIER flight via Pre-Move (-ve VOL) arriving at 15:00. The customer is mitigating by going earlier � negative VOL is NOT deducted. Full delay from promise (10:00) to actual (15:00) = 5hrs is used. Validates that negative VOL (customer mitigation) is never penalized.

checkpoints.step: And DDS checks booking change history:
checkpoints.expected: ? Change 1 (D-3): REACC auto-rebook (identifier: MUC1A06AC) ? Classification: INVOL (REACC = system-initiated auto-accommodation) ? REACC changed arrival from 10:00 ? 18:00 ? Promise update: NO � INVOL does NOT update promise ? Promise remains at: 10:00 (14-day mark) ? Change 2 (D-2): Pre-Move tool (identifier: RF-PMV / YMQAC0848) ? Classification: VOL (Pre-Move is always voluntary) ? Pre-Move changed arrival from 18:00 ? 15:00 (customer went EARLIER by -3hrs) ? Direction: NEGATIVE (-3hrs � customer chose an earlier flight than the REACC result, mitigating the delay) ? Promise update: VOL after INVOL does NOT update promise ? Promise remains at: 10:00

checkpoints.step: ? Total delay = 15:00 - 10:00 = 5 hours (actual - promise)
checkpoints.expected: ? Post-INVOL VOL direction = NEGATIVE (-3hrs � customer went EARLIER) ? Negative VOL = NOT DEDUCTED (customer is mitigating � system must NOT penalize this) ? Net delay = 5 hours (full delay, no deduction) ? APPR: Net delay 3�6h, Controllable (Code 42) ? ELIGIBLE � $400 CAD (Tier 1) ? CRITICAL ASSERTION: Customer mitigated by going earlier � system must NOT penalize this. The customer reduced their delay from 8hrs (if they stayed on the REACC flight) to 5hrs by proactively choosing an earlier flight. The full 5hr delay is used for compensation � no deduction applied. ? CONTRAST WITH POSITIVE VOL: If the customer had gone LATER (e.g., 18:00 ? 20:00 = +2hrs), that +2hrs WOULD be deducted. But going EARLIER is mitigation and is never deducted.
